summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by capturing agentic journeys through the Quadrature Nexus and FLUME VAE into SurrealDB, then using Ouroboros and Mycelium to analyze those journeys and feed synthesized patterns back into the system as a closed learning loop — run continuously overnight.
summary.outcome: Implemented and validated the full EVO closed-loop pipeline across 63 experiments and 40,000+ autoresearch runs, discovering and fixing a critical SET-vs-additive bug in `apply_mycelium_feedback` that had silently broken all prior E5/E6 attempts; derived a closed-form convergence formula; accumulated 225,550+ SurrealDB journey_point records; and merged the production fix with 11 regression tests into PR #113.

repo: `run_llm_deliberation()` unconditionally SETs `_score_adjustments[vt]` on every call — any cross-cycle Mycelium calibration must live in `_mycelium_calibration` (additive accumulator) not `_score_adjustments` (per-deliberation read surface)

The original `SurrealDBClient` was entirely simulated — `connect()` set `self.connected = True` without any real HTTP call; replaced with `RETURN true;` probe (not `SELECT 1;` which returns 400 in SurrealQL)
SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL tables reject arbitrary metadata subfields even inside a `TYPE object` column; workaround is to store EVO biography as compact JSON in the `result` field (option<string>)
SurrealQL datetime fields require `time::now()` — string literals like `'2026-05-01T21:00:00Z'` are rejected by SCHEMAFULL schema
`string::starts_with` is not supported in this SurrealDB version; use exact-match queries instead
Gemini worktrees (`.gemini/worktrees/`) are automatically cleaned up — any new code must be committed to the main repo immediately or it will be lost

`_evaluate_resource` only checked `budget_available` context and ignored description text entirely — extended to add +0.10 for cost/budget/efficient/resource/reduce keywords to make it text-sensitive like the other voices

ManifoldEnv (`src/cohezion/environments/manifold_env.py`) is the correct physics substrate for EVO experiments: 19D obs, 12D action, verifiable/curriculum/dense reward modes, HIHO convergence metric `hiho_time_ratio`

The Mycelium synthesized skill format uses `'architect: mean_score=X.XXXX'` pattern — NOT `voice_scores=[...]` (which is the ingest input format); tests that construct skill content must use the synthesized output format
IEEE 754: `sum([0.85]*10)/10 < 0.85` — for threshold crossing logic use `result.approved` (direct comparison against class constant) not a float mean comparison
The `TelemetryBus` and `JourneyWorker` both require explicit `.start()` calls at startup — without them, `emit()` silently queues events that are lost on process exit
Autoresearch experiments that call `nexus.deliberate()` directly bypass the telemetry bus entirely and generate no `journey_point` records in SurrealDB

code.finding: E57 production fix: `apply_mycelium_feedback` changed from `self._score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment` (SET — decays each cycle as observed mean creeps up) to `self._mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment; self._score_adjustments[vt] = self._mycelium_calibration[vt]` (additive accumulation). Also added `self._mycelium_calibration: dict[VoiceType, float] = dict.fromkeys(VoiceType, 0.0)` to `__init__`. Without this, every Mycelium feedback cycle replaces the previous calibration with a smaller value, causing systematic decay instead of compounding.

Full rewrite from simulation to real httpx HTTP calls. Key constraints: probe with `RETURN true;` not `SELECT 1;`; all datetime fields must use `time::now()`; SCHEMAFULL metadata rejects subfields so EVO biography goes into `result` (option<string>) as JSON; agent_journey UPSERT requires `agent_name`, `started_at`, and `transaction_time` fields.

Added `ingest_evo_journeys(event_metadata_list)` converting FlumeJourneyEvent.metadata dicts to JournalEntry with domain='evo_deliberation', and `_synthesize_evo_deliberation_skill()` extracting per-voice means. Per-voice mean extraction uses regex on 'voice_scores=[architect=0.850 engineer=0.832...]' pattern.

New file: 11 regression tests for E57 additive calibration fix. Guards E56 (cycle 2 must not decay), E57 (monotonic 5-cycle compounding), E58 (mechanism='additive_calibration'), E59 (convergence toward threshold), E60 (lr=2.0 crosses 0.85), and E62 (full pipeline lift). Skill helper must use 'architect: mean_score=X.XXXX' format matching `_synthesize_evo_deliberation_skill` output.

Added `_check_retirement()`: retires experiments with (a) 20+ keeps and CV<0.05 among last 10 metrics (converged attractor) OR (b) 0% keep rate after 20+ runs (confirmed noise). SCHEDULE label normalization needed: labels like 'E12_persist' must map to experiment key 'E12' for correct retirement tracking. Also added E63 (Mycelium closed-loop, lr=1.0 and lr=2.0), E64 (multi-cycle compounding prediction validation).

Added `check_journey_anomaly(evo_biographies, consensus_threshold=0.85)` detecting EVOs with evo_coherence < 0.50, consuming ExecutionExhaust and triggering healing. In practice fires 320+ false alarms on experimental EVO lifecycle transitions (new action key → fresh EVO from vacuum triggers coherence drop detection).

workflow: Experiments without retirement criteria run indefinitely: E51 ran 4,786 times before the stop condition was added. Retirement criterion (CV < 0.05 after 20 keeps) prevents this.
Pre-specify falsification criteria before running experiments — E50, E54, E60 all required 2-3 redesigns because the initial metric was unachievable or measured the wrong thing
`timeit.default_timer()` (= `time.perf_counter()`) is the correct instrument for experiment wall-clock timing — unaffected by NTP corrections during long runs
The `ruff format --check` pre-commit hook rejects unformatted files — must run `ruff format` before staging, not after; the hook does not auto-fix
Playwright pre-commit hook ran unconditionally (no `files:` filter) and required a running Next.js server — added `files: '^src/app/|^src/components/'` pattern to scope it

When a PR branch is 210 commits behind main, interactive rebase replays every commit through conflict resolution — safer to use `git merge-tree` to test mergeability or squash-cherry-pick unique changes only
Multiple overnight loop processes accumulated silently over the session — always check `ps aux | grep overnight_evo` before launching a new instance
SurrealDB `journey_point` table is in `cohezion/main` namespace — experiments that read the wrong namespace will see 0 records even though 225,550 exist

pre-commit ruff format hook blocked every commit attempt, requiring a format-stage-commit cycle instead of the natural stage-commit flow

Lemonade iGPU ROCm stack entered silent failure state — all evaluation prompts return empty strings but arithmetic works; the standard `/models` endpoint liveness check is insufficient, a functional probe (`2+2=`) is required

Concurrent autoresearch process started an interactive git rebase (`rebase -i`) on the working branch mid-session, leaving detached HEAD state that required `git rebase --abort` to recover
pyproject.toml had unresolved three-way merge conflicts that blocked `uv run` for the entire session until manually resolved
Multiple autorun session processes accumulated (3 PIDs visible at peak) because SIGTERM was not always received cleanly by the Python process
open_items: JEPA world model learning is flat at ~0.97-1.00 loss even with replay buffer — heuristic mode produces a single-attractor distribution with no variance; genuine JEPA learning requires LLM mode where voice scores vary. Needs LLM mode revalidation when iGPU ROCm recovers.
`apply_mycelium_feedback` has zero callers in `src/` — the E57 fix is tested but dormant in production; needs wiring into `CompoundExecutor` or the deliberation pipeline

Ouroboros fires 320+ false HIHO drift warnings on experimental EVO lifecycle transitions (fresh EVO per action key = coherence drop detected as drift) — needs a flag to distinguish experimental from production EVOs
`experiment_runs` SurrealDB table has 0 records — the HTTP-direct write code for persisting experiment metadata was in the lost Gemini worktree and was not reimplemented
E55-E62 experiments (41,983 runs in autoresearch.jsonl) bypass the telemetry bus via direct `nexus.deliberate()` calls and have no corresponding `journey_point` records in SurrealDB

Retirement criterion uses in-memory state per process — experiments retired in one session restart as active in the next; needs JSONL-seeded initialization on startup to persist retirement across restarts
E64 multi-cycle compounding (predicted threshold crossing at cycle 4 with lr=1.0) was added to the schedule but not yet confirmed with sufficient runs at session end
SwarmEnv gauge coupling strength sweep (proposed as E55) never run — the E53 finding (optimal agents sometimes score lower due to gauge interference) has an unexplored parameter space

Multi-perspective adversarial review and formal V-model experimental design workflow not implemented — each new experiment is still designed single-perspective and retrofitted with invariants after initial failures
